title: Upward Technologies vs Dutch custom software agencies
content_html:
Upward Technologies vs Dutch custom software agencies

Upward Technologies and Dutch custom software agencies both build software around your business instead of forcing your business into off-the-shelf tools. The main difference is in their approach to discovery, delivery, and what happens after the code is live. Dutch custom software agencies often dive straight into building after a conversation. Upward Technologies starts with a three-week paid scoping phase that produces a standalone requirements document and a go or no-go decision before any code is written. Both host and support what they build. The choice comes down to your team's size, budget, and how much certainty you need before committing to a project.

What Dutch custom software agencies are good at

Dutch custom software agencies have deep experience building enterprise software. Many have worked across multiple industries and can bring patterns from one sector into another. They often field larger teams than smaller software shops, which means they can handle complex, multi-year projects with many moving parts. Some agencies specialise in specific domains (manufacturing, logistics, healthcare) and carry that expertise into every project they take on.

Agencies also tend to have established relationships with hosting providers and infrastructure partners, which can speed up the deployment of what they build. If you need a team that can staff up quickly or bring deep experience in your industry, a larger Dutch agency is often the right choice.

What Upward Technologies does differently

Upward Technologies is a smaller software company based in Breda that focuses on taking manual, repetitive work off your team's hands. It starts every project with a three-week paid scoping phase. This phase produces a written requirements document, a clear picture of what the software will do, and a decision point where you can walk away if the scope or cost doesn't fit. You could take that document to another supplier if you chose to. This front-loaded discovery removes the risk of scope creep and misalignment later.

Upward Technologies also builds AI agents and automation into its projects as standard. If your problem involves manual data entry, retyping between tools, or repetitive business processes, AI agents are often part of the solution. The company also offers ready-made products for specific workflows: Bookwise for bookkeeping in Dutch BV groups (live since 1 October 2026), Reach for B2B outreach, GTM for AI-driven go-to-market content, DocSign for e-signatures, Transfer for secure file transfer, and Assure for ISO 27001 document control (in beta). If your need fits one of these products, you can start there instead of building from scratch.

Upward Technologies also develops ERIS, an all-in-one business software suite. ERIS is not available today. Its beta with design partners begins in November 2026, and the full release is planned for January 2027. You can join the design partner programme at upwardtech.nl/en/products/eris.

Both Upward Technologies and Dutch custom software agencies host and support the software they build. Neither hands the code to your IT team and walks away. Both can integrate your existing systems so data flows between tools without retyping. The main structural difference is the scoping phase: Upward Technologies makes it explicit and paid, while most agencies treat discovery as part of the project itself.

How to choose

Pick a Dutch custom software agency if:

You need a large team mobilised quickly. If your project requires 10 or more people or spans multiple years, an established agency can scale faster than a smaller shop. You also benefit from their experience if your industry has specific regulatory or technical requirements they have solved before. Many larger agencies have deep expertise in manufacturing, logistics, financial services or healthcare, and that experience is worth paying for.

Pick Upward Technologies if:

Your team loses hours to manual work, retyping between tools, or spreadsheets that have outgrown their purpose. You want a clear requirements document and a decision point before building starts. You want to know upfront what the software will do and what it will cost, without discovering hidden scope halfway through. You also benefit if your workflow involves integrating ERP and CRM systems, or if AI agents for business processes are part of the solution. If you need one of Upward Technologies's ready-made products (bookkeeping, outreach automation, e-signatures, secure file transfer, or ISO 27001 compliance tracking) you can start there instead of a custom build.

Pick both if:

You need a large agency to handle the core system, but want Upward Technologies to build and run smaller automation projects or integrations alongside it. Some teams use both: a larger agency for the main platform, and Upward Technologies for specific workflows that need custom AI or integration work.

FAQ

What is the difference between Upward Technologies and a Dutch custom software agency?

Both build custom software and host what they deliver. Upward Technologies starts with a three-week paid scoping phase that produces a requirements document before any code is written. Most Dutch custom software agencies begin building after an initial conversation. Upward Technologies is smaller and focuses on automation and AI agents for manual work. Larger Dutch agencies can field bigger teams and often carry deep expertise in specific industries.

Do Dutch custom software agencies also do a scoping phase?

Most Dutch custom software agencies do discovery work before building, but it is usually treated as part of the project itself rather than a separate, paid phase with a written deliverable and a go or no-go decision. Upward Technologies makes the scoping phase explicit: three weeks, paid, and ending with a document you could take to another supplier if you chose to.

Can I use Upward Technologies and a Dutch custom software agency on the same project?

Yes. Some teams use a larger agency for the main system and Upward Technologies for specific automation, integration, or AI agent work that sits alongside it. The two can work in parallel or in sequence.

What does Upward Technologies do after the software is built?

Upward Technologies hosts and supports the software it builds. Your IT team does not install or maintain it. The company also runs what it builds, so if the software needs updates, fixes or changes, Upward Technologies handles them. This is the same model most custom software agencies use.

Does Upward Technologies work with companies outside the Netherlands?

Upward Technologies is based in Breda and focuses on Dutch SMEs and mid-market companies. If you are outside the Netherlands, a local custom software agency in your country may be better positioned to understand your local regulations and business context.

When should I pick a larger agency over Upward Technologies?

Pick a larger agency if your project is complex, multi-year, or requires a team of 10 or more people. Also pick an agency if your industry has specific requirements (manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, financial services) and the agency has solved those problems before. Upward Technologies works best for smaller, focused projects where the problem is clear and the scope is contained.
